event.text: Looking for AI Platform tenders open now (40,032 open bids in that window; 132 look relevant from their titles).

bid.title: AI Based Deep Fake Videos Analysis Tool with Supported Hardware
bid.buyer: Ministry of Defence / Department of Military Affairs
bid.reason: The tender explicitly requires an 'AI/ML Analysis Engine' with 'Multi-Modal Deepfake Detection' capabilities, which constitutes a specialized AI platform for building and deploying specific AI models for video analysis.

evidence.quote: The core engine employs a suite of advanced AI/ML models to analyse files from multiple perspectives for higher accuracy.
For on-premises deployments, all AI model processing occurs locally, advanced analysis can be done using Global Threat intelligence in India.
The final Deepfake Probability Score is generated by an ensemble model that intelligently weighs the outputs from all individual analyses, increasing reliability and reducing false positives.

key_facts.scope_summary: Supply of AI-based deepfake detection software and high-performance hardware workstations for the Indian Army.

bid.title: Artificial intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning as a Service - Development, Integratio
bid.buyer: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / HUDCO
bid.reason: The tender explicitly requires an AI platform to build, train, and deploy models for automating procurement tasks like cost estimation and evaluation criteria generation.

evidence.quote: The solution shall provide AI-driven budget estimation using historical tenders, similar projects with BOQ-level cost analysis, variance assessment, and bid reasonableness evaluation

The Bidder shall set up, train, and validate the Platform’s AI agents responsible for the automated generation of evaluation criteria, scoring frameworks, and technical checklists based on ingested tender documents.

The Bidder shall ensure that no input data, prompts, outputs, logs, or metadata generated or processed under this project are used for training, re-training, fine-tuning, or improvement of any external, third-party, or proprietary AI/ML models outside the scope of this engagement.

key_facts.scope_summary: AI platform for automating tender document processing, cost benchmarking, and evaluation criteria generation with strict data sovereignty and human-in-the-loop validation.
